Draw labelled genomic spans

Source: R/seq_span_strip.R
seq_span_strip.Rd

Draws a coloured bar over each genomic span with a text label at the span centre. Spans are clipped to each window. With bar_height = 0 only the labels are drawn.

Usage

seq_span_strip(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  legend = NULL,
  legend_extra = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "canvas_margin",
  legend_side = "right",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A GRanges with one row per span.

mapping

A SeqMap. Fields: x0 (default start), x1 (default end), label, fill (concrete colours; NA gives grey70).

aesthetics

A SeqAes. Recognised: bar_height (fraction of the panel height, default 0.35), bar_y (bar centre as a panel fraction, default 0.5), label_cex (0.6), label_position ("above" or "inside"), alpha (1).

legend

NULL for no key, FALSE for none, or a SeqLegendSpec or list of LegendKey used as given.

legend_extra

List of LegendKey appended to the legend.

show_legend

Logical. FALSE suppresses the legend.

legend_position, legend_side

Placement of the generated legend.

...

Unused.

Value

A SeqSpanStripR6 instance.

Examples

gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(c(1, 500), c(400, 900)),
  name = c("a", "b"), col = c("tomato", "steelblue"))
seq_span_strip(gr, map(label = name, fill = col))
